<!DOCTYPE html>

<script type="module">
import * as THREE from 'three';
import { RoundedBoxGeometry } from 'three/addons/geometries/RoundedBoxGeometry.js';

const scene = new THREE.Scene();
scene.background = new THREE.Color(0xf2e4ea);

const renderer = new THREE.WebGLRenderer({
  antialias: true,
  preserveDrawingBuffer: true
});
renderer.setPixelRatio(1);
renderer.setSize(240, 240);
renderer.outputColorSpace = THREE.SRGBColorSpace;
renderer.toneMapping = THREE.ACESFilmicToneMapping;
renderer.toneMappingExposure = 1.12;
renderer.shadowMap.enabled = true;
renderer.shadowMap.type = THREE.PCFSoftShadowMap;
document.body.appendChild(renderer.domElement);

const ref = new THREE.OrthographicCamera(-2.35, 2.35, 2.35, -2.35, 0.1, 100);
ref.position.set(3.0, 2.9, 8.5);
ref.lookAt(0, 1.9, 0);

const yellow = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0xffd43b,
  roughness: 0.58
});
const lipYellow = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0xf3bf2d,
  roughness: 0.62
});
const bellyYellow = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0xfff0ae,
  roughness: 0.72
});
const orange = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0xeaa137,
  roughness: 0.6
});
const mouthDark = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0x49151f,
  roughness: 0.76
});
const tonguePink = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0xf1787f,
  roughness: 0.62
});
const tongueLine = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0xc95668,
  roughness: 0.7
});
const toothWhite = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0xfff9e7,
  roughness: 0.42
});
const eyeBrown = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0x38251a,
  roughness: 0.72
});
const blush = new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({
  color: 0xf3a05c,
  roughness: 0.75
});

const unitSphere = new THREE.SphereGeometry(1, 48, 32);

function makeGroup(name, parent, position = [0, 0, 0]) {
  const g = new THREE.Group();
  g.name = name;
  g.position.set(...position);
  parent.add(g);
  return g;
}

function ellipsoid(parent, name, position, scale, material, rotation = [0, 0, 0]) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(unitSphere, material);
  m.name = name;
  m.position.set(...position);
  m.scale.set(...scale);
  m.rotation.set(...rotation);
  parent.add(m);
  return m;
}

function capsuleBetween(parent, name, a, b, radius, material) {
  const start = new THREE.Vector3(...a);
  const end = new THREE.Vector3(...b);
  const direction = end.clone().sub(start);
  const length = direction.length();
  const geometry = new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(
    radius,
    Math.max(0.001, length - 2 * radius),
    8,
    20
  );
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(geometry, material);
  m.name = name;
  m.position.copy(start).add(end).multiplyScalar(0.5);
  m.quaternion.setFromUnitVectors(
    new THREE.Vector3(0, 1, 0),
    direction.normalize()
  );
  parent.add(m);
  return m;
}

function tube(parent, name, curve, radius, material, segments = 40) {
  const m = new THREE.Mesh(
    new THREE.TubeGeometry(curve, segments, radius, 10, false),
    material
  );
  m.name = name;
  parent.add(m);
  return m;
}

function taperedTube(points, radii, segments = 56, radialSegments = 18) {
  const curve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(points);
  const frames = curve.computeFrenetFrames(segments, false);
  const positions = [];
  const indices = [];

  for (let i = 0; i <= segments; i++) {
    const t = i / segments;
    const center = curve.getPointAt(t);
    const k = t * (radii.length - 1);
    const ri = Math.min(Math.floor(k), radii.length - 2);
    const radius = THREE.MathUtils.lerp(radii[ri], radii[ri + 1], k - ri);

    for (let j = 0; j <= radialSegments; j++) {
      const angle = j / radialSegments * Math.PI * 2;
      const c = -Math.cos(angle) * radius;
      const s = Math.sin(angle) * radius;
      positions.push(
        center.x + c * frames.normals[i].x + s * frames.binormals[i].x,
        center.y + c * frames.normals[i].y + s * frames.binormals[i].y,
        center.z + c * frames.normals[i].z + s * frames.binormals[i].z
      );
    }
  }

  for (let i = 1; i <= segments; i++) {
    for (let j = 1; j <= radialSegments; j++) {
      const a = (radialSegments + 1) * (i - 1) + j - 1;
      const b = (radialSegments + 1) * i + j - 1;
      const c = (radialSegments + 1) * i + j;
      const d = (radialSegments + 1) * (i - 1) + j;
      indices.push(a, b, d, b, c, d);
    }
  }

  const startCenter = positions.length / 3;
  const start = curve.getPointAt(0);
  positions.push(start.x, start.y, start.z);
  for (let j = 0; j < radialSegments; j++) {
    indices.push(startCenter, j, j + 1);
  }

  const endCenter = positions.length / 3;
  const end = curve.getPointAt(1);
  positions.push(end.x, end.y, end.z);
  const endRing = segments * (radialSegments + 1);
  for (let j = 0; j < radialSegments; j++) {
    indices.push(endCenter, endRing + j + 1, endRing + j);
  }

  const geometry = new THREE.BufferGeometry();
  geometry.setAttribute('position', new THREE.Float32BufferAttribute(positions, 3));
  geometry.setIndex(indices);
  geometry.computeVertexNormals();
  return geometry;
}

const character = makeGroup('character-laughing-nailong', scene);

const body = makeGroup('body', character);
ellipsoid(body, 'round-torso', [0, 0.96, 0], [1.0, 1.0, 0.8], yellow);
ellipsoid(body, 'cream-belly', [0, 0.89, 0.69], [0.72, 0.70, 0.16], bellyYellow);
ellipsoid(body, 'left-haunch', [-0.61, 0.48, 0.02], [0.46, 0.46, 0.48], yellow);
ellipsoid(body, 'right-haunch', [0.61, 0.48, 0.02], [0.46, 0.46, 0.48], yellow);

const head = makeGroup('head', character, [0, 2.38, 0.02]);
head.rotation.set(-0.10, 0, -0.025);
ellipsoid(head, 'large-round-head', [0, 0.18, 0], [1.28, 1.08, 0.96], yellow);
ellipsoid(head, 'laughing-lower-jaw', [0, -0.46, 0.02], [1.03, 0.60, 0.82], yellow);

const horns = makeGroup('horns', head);
for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const horn = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.CapsuleGeometry(0.115, 0.25, 8, 20), orange);
  horn.name = side < 0 ? 'left-rounded-horn' : 'right-rounded-horn';
  horn.position.set(side * 0.53, 1.17, -0.06);
  horn.rotation.z = -side * 0.29;
  horns.add(horn);
  ellipsoid(
    horns,
    side < 0 ? 'left-horn-base' : 'right-horn-base',
    [side * 0.50, 1.03, -0.04],
    [0.18, 0.13, 0.16],
    yellow
  );
}

const eyes = makeGroup('eyes', head);
tube(
  eyes,
  'left-squeezed-laughing-eye',
  new THREE.QuadraticBezierCurve3(
    new THREE.Vector3(-0.79, 0.48, 0.79),
    new THREE.Vector3(-0.55, 0.72, 0.92),
    new THREE.Vector3(-0.30, 0.49, 0.94)
  ),
  0.043,
  eyeBrown
);
tube(
  eyes,
  'right-squeezed-laughing-eye',
  new THREE.QuadraticBezierCurve3(
    new THREE.Vector3(0.30, 0.49, 0.94),
    new THREE.Vector3(0.55, 0.72, 0.92),
    new THREE.Vector3(0.79, 0.48, 0.79)
  ),
  0.043,
  eyeBrown
);

const muzzle = makeGroup('muzzle', head);
ellipsoid(muzzle, 'rounded-snout', [0, 0.16, 0.73], [0.54, 0.30, 0.31], yellow);
ellipsoid(muzzle, 'left-nostril', [-0.17, 0.27, 1.025], [0.045, 0.032, 0.025], eyeBrown);
ellipsoid(muzzle, 'right-nostril', [0.17, 0.27, 1.025], [0.045, 0.032, 0.025], eyeBrown);

ellipsoid(head, 'left-laughing-cheek', [-0.99, -0.05, 0.61], [0.16, 0.10, 0.04], blush, [0, -0.65, 0]);
ellipsoid(head, 'right-laughing-cheek', [0.99, -0.05, 0.61], [0.16, 0.10, 0.04], blush, [0, 0.65, 0]);

const mouth = makeGroup('mouth', head, [0, -0.15, 0]);
const mouthShape = new THREE.Shape();
mouthShape.moveTo(-0.78, 0.22);
mouthShape.bezierCurveTo(-0.48, 0.40, 0.48, 0.40, 0.78, 0.22);
mouthShape.bezierCurveTo(0.82, -0.16, 0.55, -0.55, 0, -0.61);
mouthShape.bezierCurveTo(-0.55, -0.55, -0.82, -0.16, -0.78, 0.22);

function mouthZ(x, y) {
  return 0.94 - 0.26 * x * x + 0.24 * y;
}

const mouthGeometry = new THREE.ExtrudeGeometry(mouthShape, {
  depth: 0.08,
  steps: 1,
  bevelEnabled: true,
  bevelSegments: 4,
  bevelSize: 0.025,
  bevelThickness: 0.025,
  curveSegments: 36
});
const mouthPositions = mouthGeometry.attributes.position;
for (let i = 0; i < mouthPositions.count; i++) {
  const x = mouthPositions.getX(i);
  const y = mouthPositions.getY(i);
  mouthPositions.setZ(i, mouthPositions.getZ(i) + mouthZ(x, y));
}
mouthPositions.needsUpdate = true;
mouthGeometry.computeVertexNormals();

const cavity = new THREE.Mesh(mouthGeometry, mouthDark);
cavity.name = 'deep-open-laughing-mouth';
mouth.add(cavity);

const outline = mouthShape.getPoints(72);
if (outline[0].distanceTo(outline[outline.length - 1]) < 0.001) outline.pop();
const lipCurve = new THREE.CatmullRomCurve3(
  outline.map(p => new THREE.Vector3(p.x, p.y, mouthZ(p.x, p.y) + 0.09)),
  true
);
const lip = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.TubeGeometry(lipCurve, 144, 0.055, 12, true),
  lipYellow
);
lip.name = 'rounded-smiling-lip-rim';
mouth.add(lip);

const teeth = makeGroup('upper-teeth', mouth);
for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const tooth = new THREE.Mesh(
    new RoundedBoxGeometry(0.23, 0.26, 0.11, 3, 0.045),
    toothWhite
  );
  tooth.name = side < 0 ? 'left-front-tooth' : 'right-front-tooth';
  tooth.position.set(side * 0.14, 0.18, mouthZ(side * 0.14, 0.18) + 0.11);
  tooth.rotation.z = side * 0.04;
  teeth.add(tooth);
}

const tongue = makeGroup('tongue', mouth);
ellipsoid(
  tongue,
  'pink-tongue',
  [0, -0.36, mouthZ(0, -0.36) + 0.115],
  [0.46, 0.16, 0.075],
  tonguePink,
  [-0.10, 0, 0]
);
tube(
  tongue,
  'tongue-center-groove',
  new THREE.QuadraticBezierCurve3(
    new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.47, mouthZ(0, -0.36) + 0.185),
    new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.37, mouthZ(0, -0.36) + 0.198),
    new THREE.Vector3(0, -0.29, mouthZ(0, -0.36) + 0.18)
  ),
  0.008,
  tongueLine,
  16
);

for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const label = side < 0 ? 'left' : 'right';
  const arm = makeGroup(`${label}-arm`, character);
  capsuleBetween(
    arm,
    `${label}-upper-arm`,
    [side * 0.82, 1.43, 0.03],
    [side * 1.10, 1.08, 0.25],
    0.18,
    yellow
  );
  ellipsoid(
    arm,
    `${label}-elbow`,
    [side * 1.10, 1.08, 0.25],
    [0.19, 0.19, 0.19],
    yellow
  );
  capsuleBetween(
    arm,
    `${label}-forearm`,
    [side * 1.08, 1.06, 0.28],
    [side * 0.79, 0.88, 0.67],
    0.17,
    yellow
  );
  const hand = makeGroup(`${label}-hand`, arm);
  ellipsoid(
    hand,
    `${label}-belly-holding-hand`,
    [side * 0.69, 0.88, 0.77],
    [0.26, 0.22, 0.18],
    yellow,
    [0, side * 0.15, side * 0.18]
  );
  for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
    ellipsoid(
      hand,
      `${label}-rounded-finger-${i + 2}`,
      [side * (0.65 + i * 0.065), 0.80, 0.90],
      [0.052, 0.10, 0.055],
      yellow,
      [0, 0, side * -0.15]
    );
  }
}

for (const side of [-1, 1]) {
  const label = side < 0 ? 'left' : 'right';
  const foot = makeGroup(`${label}-foot`, character, [side * 0.54, 0.25, 0.22]);
  foot.rotation.y = side * 0.17;
  ellipsoid(foot, `${label}-wide-foot`, [0, 0, 0], [0.47, 0.25, 0.60], yellow);
  for (let i = -1; i <= 1; i++) {
    ellipsoid(
      foot,
      `${label}-toenail-${i + 2}`,
      [i * 0.18, 0.035, 0.555 - Math.abs(i) * 0.035],
      [0.08, 0.06, 0.09],
      toothWhite
    );
  }
}

const tail = makeGroup('tail', character);
const tailMesh = new THREE.Mesh(
  taperedTube(
    [
      new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.73, -0.62),
      new THREE.Vector3(0, 0.48, -1.05),
      new THREE.Vector3(0.48, 0.37, -1.27),
      new THREE.Vector3(0.95, 0.50, -1.12),
      new THREE.Vector3(1.04, 0.73, -0.92)
    ],
    [0.30, 0.26, 0.18, 0.09, 0.015]
  ),
  yellow
);
tailMesh.name = 'curled-solid-tail';
tail.add(tailMesh);

const dorsalSpikes = makeGroup('dorsal-spikes', character);
function addSpike(parent, name, position, radius, height) {
  const g = makeGroup(name, parent, position);
  const cone = new THREE.Mesh(new THREE.ConeGeometry(radius, height, 24), orange);
  cone.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
  g.add(cone);
  ellipsoid(g, `${name}-soft-tip`, [0, 0, -height / 2], [0.045, 0.045, 0.045], orange);
}
addSpike(dorsalSpikes, 'upper-back-spike', [0, 1.62, -0.72], 0.17, 0.34);
addSpike(dorsalSpikes, 'middle-back-spike', [0, 1.15, -0.84], 0.18, 0.36);
addSpike(dorsalSpikes, 'lower-back-spike', [0, 0.72, -0.76], 0.15, 0.30);
addSpike(head, 'head-back-spike', [0, 0.48, -0.89], 0.15, 0.32);

character.traverse(object => {
  if (object.isMesh) {
    object.castShadow = true;
    object.receiveShadow = true;
  }
});

const ground = new THREE.Mesh(
  new THREE.PlaneGeometry(200, 200),
  new THREE.MeshStandardMaterial({ color: 0xf2e4ea, roughness: 0.95 })
);
ground.name = 'studio-ground';
ground.rotation.x = -Math.PI / 2;
ground.position.y = -0.035;
ground.receiveShadow = true;
scene.add(ground);

const hemisphere = new THREE.HemisphereLight(0xfff8ec, 0x8f7f91, 1.85);
scene.add(hemisphere);

const key = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff3df, 3.1);
key.position.set(-3.5, 7, 5);
key.castShadow = true;
key.shadow.mapSize.set(1024, 1024);
key.shadow.camera.left = -5;
key.shadow.camera.right = 5;
key.shadow.camera.top = 6;
key.shadow.camera.bottom = -3;
key.shadow.camera.near = 0.1;
key.shadow.camera.far = 20;
key.shadow.bias = -0.0003;
key.shadow.normalBias = 0.02;
key.target.position.set(0, 1.6, 0);
scene.add(key, key.target);

const fill = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xe8f2ff, 1.05);
fill.position.set(4, 3.5, 3);
scene.add(fill);

const rim = new THREE.DirectionalLight(0xfff1cf, 1.35);
rim.position.set(-2, 4.5, -5);
scene.add(rim);

function render(t) {
  renderer.render(scene, ref);
}

window.nwb = {
  scene,
  renderer,
  cameras: { ref },
  characters: [character],
  render,
  ready: true
};

render(0);
</script>
